request.objective: Start at https://www.target.com/. Search for a job in Miami, Florida, in Human Resources on target.

response.result:
Searching Target's careers site for **Human Resources** jobs in **Miami, FL** returns **6 results**, filtered to "Within 25 Miles" of Miami — both filters show as active on the results page, and there is no second page of results.

The six listings:

1. **Executive Team Leader Human Resources (Assistant Manager HR) | North Miami, FL** — 16901 Miramar Pkwy, Miramar, FL · Store Leadership · Full-time · $64,000 – $128,000
2. **Target Security Specialist** — 1750 W 37th St, Hialeah, FL · Store Hourly · Part-time · no pay listed
3. **Store Executive Intern (Store Leadership Intern) – Miami – Starting Summer 2027** — 249 NW 6th St, Ste 120, Miami, FL · Internships · Part-time · no pay listed
4. **Target Security Specialist** — 14075 Biscayne Blvd, North Miami Beach, FL · Store Hourly · Part-time · no pay listed
5. **Target Security Specialist** — 3251 Hollywood Blvd, Hollywood, FL · Store Hourly · Part-time · no pay listed
6. **General Merchandise Team Leader** — 16901 Miramar Pkwy, Miramar, FL · Store Hourly · Full-time · $21.50 – $23.50 per hour

Worth knowing: only the first result is an actual HR position. The other five are store and security postings that the keyword match pulls in — so if you want HR work specifically, listing #1 is the real hit and the rest are noise. Pay is shown on just two of the six; the others carry no wage on the results page.

One practical detail: target.com itself has no careers link in its menu, so the search was run on Target's corporate careers site at corporate.target.com/careers/job-search.
